رَفِيضٌ i. q. ↓ مَرْفُوضٌ , applied to a thing; (S, K;) i. e. Left; forsaken; relinquished; abandoned; deserted: (S, TA:) cast away: separated; dispersed; scattered: (TA:) and, applied to a spear, broken in pieces. (K.) ＝
-A2- Sweat; (O, K;) because of its flowing. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
